summary.motive: Create catastrophic quarterback turnovers on long passing downs by bluffing an all-out 7-man blitz and dropping 8 defenders into a suffocating Tampa 2 shell with the middle linebacker running the pole.
summary.keyDefender: MIKE (Deep Middle Pole Runner) & WILL (Intermediate Hook Dropper)
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses keep extra blockers in pass protection to pick up the 7-man bluff, leaving 4 or 5 receivers completely outnumbered by 8 defenders in layered coverage.
summary.failureMode: A patient quarterback who checks down to a shallow underneath crosser and lets a playmaker run after the catch against retreating defenders.

beats.title: 7-Man Psycho Mug Presentation
beats.text: Todd Bowles crowds 7 defenders on the line of scrimmage, showing an unavoidable all-out Cover 0 house blitz to force the offense into a max-protect check and quick hot reads.

beats.title: The Great Drop-8 Retreat
beats.text: At the snap, only 3 rushers engage! Four front defenders instantly bail backwards into coverage, while MIKE sprints full-speed down the deep middle pole (Tampa 2).

beats.title: Hot Read Baited into Turnover
beats.text: The QB throws his designated hot seam to Y expecting an empty middle, only to find the sprinting MIKE linebacker undercutting the ball for an interception.

beats.title: Escorted Return Downfield
beats.text: With 8 defensive backs and linebackers already deployed across the field, MIKE is escorted by a wall of blockers on a huge turnover return.

relations.tell: 7-man front shows all-out heat, then 4 line-of-scrimmage defenders turn their backs and sprint into coverage zones at the snap
